input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the uploaded file only on `"
"` (`text.split("
")`). Files exported from Windows tools use CRLF (`
`) line endings, so each line (including the header) retains a trailing ``. This shifts/garbles the last column of the header and every row, causing the column-count mismatch and the "Malformed row" error reported on row 1 (the header itself). The fix should normalize line endings (e.g. strip `` or split on `/
|
/`) before parsing.

text: This confirms the bug: CSV parsing splits on `\n` only, so Windows CRLF line endings leave a trailing `\r` on the header/columns, causing the column-count mismatch reported as "row 1".
